subject: Eval ops: minimal-exposure playbook — timeline, privacy gate & appeals flow
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Eval ops: minimal-exposure playbook — timeline, privacy gate & appeals flow

Team —

Summary: I put together a compact plan to run this year's performance cycle with an explicit "minimal exposure" path for sensitive roles and a short appeals window. The goal is to reduce distributed material, shorten the window between manager calibration and ratings lock, and create a small, auditable appeals queue.

High-level proposal (draft):
- Manager calibration: Jul 12–14 — live calibration sessions (managers only).
- Privacy gate: Jul 16 — restrict distribution of full packets to L2+; manager summaries allowed for direct reports only.
- Quiet period (no org comms): Jul 17–20 — blocked for exec comms, limited HR access.
- Appeals open: Jul 21–23 — 48-hour appeals intake and triage.
- Final ratings lock: Jul 25 09:00 PT — commits to HR systems.

Attachments: manager_scripts_v1.docx (talking points + escalation language), privacy_gate_checklist.xlsx, appeals_flow_diagram.pdf.

Asks:
1) Please review the privacy gate checklist and confirm the list of people who need packet access.
2) Agree/adjust the appeals window. My thinking: short and decisive, but with a single HR partner assigned per region to avoid diffusion.
3) Any legal/compliance flags we should surface now?

I'll iterate off your comments and then route a version to People Ops and the external auditor we worked with last year for a quick sanity check.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
VP, People Strategy | Redwood Inference
 k: +1 (415) 555-0130

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval ops: minimal-exposure playbook — timeline, privacy gate & appeals flow

Karthik —

Thanks for the concise plan. A few quick notes:
- Please make the privacy gate accessor list explicit (by role or by name) — we should avoid "L2+" ambiguity for managers who span orgs.
- I want a short training video (10m) for managers covering: what to share, how to document conversations, and the appeals submission form. Monica, can People Ops own that?
- Legal should review the appeals language around "final" ratings — cc'ing Monica to loop them in and confirm if we need a narrow exceptions policy.

If everyone is aligned I'll greenlight the calibration dates and we can publish a manager calendar invite.

-Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Engineering Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval ops: minimal-exposure playbook — timeline, privacy gate & appeals flow

Quick edits from infra/ops perspective:
1) Split the privacy gate into two stages: (a) packet freeze at Jul 15 23:59; (b) controlled release on Jul 16 after named approvers sign the checklist. We need the freeze timestamp to ensure auditability.
2) Limit distribution lists to managers + HR partner; any cross-functional distro should go through a ticketed request (Jira: HS-5324).
3) Add an audit-log step into the checklist: every access must record who and why (we already have S3 access logs but we need a simple manager-facing confirmation).

Also recommending a short sample IC comm we can reuse so managers don't over-share. I'll draft one and attach.

Vivek

Begin forwarded message:

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 at 08:44:12 -0700
To: audit@candorconsulting.com
Subject: Eval ops: minimal-exposure playbook — can you review appeals flow?

Hi Candor team —

We're running a compact performance cycle with an emphasis on limiting distribution of sensitive materials. Attached is our proposed appeals_flow_diagram.pdf and the privacy_gate_checklist.xlsx. Can you: 
1) Confirm the appeals intake timing is reasonable (48 hours).
2) Verify our proposed ticketing steps are sufficient for audit purposes.
3) Call out any evidence we should preserve for potential later reviews.

Please advise by EOD Monday so we can lock the timeline.

Thanks,
Monica
--
Monica Patel
People Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachments: appeals_flow_diagram.pdf (diagram, v1)

From: Candor Consulting <audit@candorconsulting.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval ops: minimal-exposure playbook — review request

Monica —

Thanks for the packet. Quick read: the structure is sound. A couple of suggestions from an auditability and fairness standpoint: 
- Keep the 48-hour window but build a 24-hour "triage" SLA where HR acknowledges receipt and assigns an owner; that buy-in reduces back-and-forth.
- Shift the final ratings lock by +48 hours (to Jul 27 09:00 PT) to allow backlog processing in case there are concentration spikes in appeals.
- Ensure the appeals ticket captures the manager's original packet snapshot (we recommend a checksum or archived PDF) to prevent mid-process edits.

We can draft a 1-page evidence checklist for you by Monday. Shared notes link: https://candor.consulting/s/redwood/notes/2027-eval

—Sara O'Neill
Senior Audit Consultant, Candor Consulting

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Eval ops minimal-exposure playbook — decisions & next steps

Thanks all — decisions captured below (final for operations):
- Privacy gate: two-stage freeze + sign-off (Vivek to update checklist with freeze timestamp).
- Manager training: Monica to own the 10m video and the single-page manager quicksheet (deadline: Jul 5).
- Appeals: keep 48-hour intake window; add 24-hour HR triage SLA; Candor to supply evidence checklist (Monica to collect).
- Timeline: calibration Jul 12–14; packet freeze Jul 15 23:59; controlled release Jul 16; quiet Jul 17–20; appeals Jul 21–23; ratings lock Jul 27 09:00 PT (updated per audit feedback).

Next steps: Vivek, update privacy_gate_checklist.xlsx with the freeze timestamp and audit-log row. Monica, prep training materials and confirm People Ops owner list by Jul 2. I'll publish the manager calendar and lock the invites once we have confirmation.

Thanks — this keeps the cycle tight while providing a clear, auditable path for sensitive cases.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
VP, People Strategy | Redwood Inference
